author: deepaks2
title: GPU BatchReplicatedBranches clang-tidy braces-around-statements errors
signature: clang-tidy readability-braces-around-statements error if statement missing braces treated as warning as error|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build-gpu / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Cmake build with clang-tidy enabled fails compiling batch_replicated_branches.cpp with 10 readability-braces-around-statements errors

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_clang_tidy
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails because Build-gpu / Build failed

key_errors: 10 warnings treated as errors (lines 123, 148, 156, 162, 176, 189, 206, 227, 245, 284 of batch_replicated_branches.cpp)
root_cause: The new PR file src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/plugin/transformations/batch_replicated_branches.cpp uses single-statement if/for bodies without curly braces at 10 locations (lines 123, 148, 156, 162, 176, 189, 206, 227, 245, 284). The GPU build job compiles with clang-tidy enabled and CMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON, so the readability-braces-around-statements clang-tidy check is promoted to a hard build error, failing the Cmake build step and cascading to the aggregate clang-tidy status job.
reproduction_steps: Build the GPU plugin locally with clang-tidy enabled and warnings-as-errors: cmake -DENABLE_CLANG_TIDY=ON -DCMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON ... && cmake --build . --target openvino_intel_gpu_plugin ; clang-tidy-18 will flag every brace-less if/for statement in batch_replicated_branches.cpp as an error.
recommended_actions: Add curly braces around the single-statement bodies of all 10 flagged if/for statements in src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/plugin/transformations/batch_replicated_branches.cpp (lines 123, 148, 156, 162, 176, 189, 206, 227, 245, 284).
Run clang-tidy-18 locally (or `clang-format`/`.clang-tidy` checks) on the changed file before pushing to catch readability-braces-around-statements violations early.
Re-push once fixed; no other code changes are implicated by this failure.
prevention_strategies: Run the repository's clang-tidy pre-commit/lint target locally on new/changed files before opening a PR, especially for new GPU plugin transformation files. Consider enabling a local pre-commit hook that runs clang-tidy with the same flags as CI (--extra-arg, -Werror) to surface these as early as possible.
historical_context: Matches a recurring signature (a4282c65071120e2) previously seen twice for PR #38641 (GPU remove_redundant_reorders) with the same readability-braces-around-statements clang-tidy violation pattern, now recorded a 3rd time for a different file/PR. This confirms brace-less single-statement bodies are a common oversight in new GPU plugin transformation code under the clang-tidy-enabled build.
